TraceFence plugin: disk-clean 3.3.2
Implementation: independent Swift implementation for MacToolsPluginKit
Capability and algorithm reference: https://github.com/137137137/OpenDisk
Reference commit: 16765d0a13cdb38ab1c2db1391ef3d9e2b9af30e

mount-point boundaries, and streaming aggregation
Retained TraceFence controls: fd-anchored no-follow traversal, scan artifacts,
expiry gate, identity revalidation, exclusion roots, and fail-closed cleanup plans
